name: website-redesign
title: Website Redesign
description: Transform an existing site visually and structurally while preserving useful content and functionality.
when_to_use: An existing site looks dated or converts poorly and the client wants a new look.
instructions: Redesign presentation, hierarchy and UX; carry over content, URLs and functionality that still serve users.
Present the redesign direction before full implementation when an approval gate is configured.
Every removed element needs a reason in the change log.
